scope: Real macOS Chromium GPU; phone-size viewport is emulation, not physical-phone acceptance

reflection.note: Room-positioned PMREM reflections only. This is not a lightmap or diffuse global illumination bake.

mirror.note: Two reflectors are attached to the final moving bath mirror leaves with recursive bounces disabled. Live output remains unverified until rendered on the selected backend. Three.js updates them only when visible mirror faces are rendered.
